frozen_populations.agsi_definition: An ACTION-GATING STATE ITEM (AGSI) is a (anchor, field_name) pair whose value is (a) the value attribute of an <input>, <textarea> or <select> belonging to a <form> whose method is not GET; or (b) the content attribute of a <meta> element whose name is in the frozen capability-token name list. Gating is STRUCTURAL, never behavioural; write verbs are forbidden.
frozen_populations.agsi_instance_key: (anchor_id, field_name, structure_signature) plus a document-order occurrence ordinal assigned among occurrences of the same key within a session. A key contributes guard trials iff its occurrence count is IDENTICAL in the recorded session and in every current session it is paired with; keys with unequal counts are EXCLUDED and counted in M-N-AGSI-EXCLUDED-UNSTABLE. This is the DESIGN-time repair of the parent's field_name-only keying, which required exactly one occurrence and therefore dropped CAL-POS-1 entirely.
frozen_populations.recovered_value_definition: For an AGSI, the recovered exact value is the literal attribute string after HTML entity decoding, byte-for-byte; empty string means PRESENT-EMPTY; an absent attribute or absent field means ABSENT. Value comparison is byte-exact.
frozen_populations.session_scoped_qualification: An anchor's AGSI (per path) qualifies SESSION-SCOPED iff its URL returned HTTP 200 in at least 3 of the 4 sessions AND n_distinct_exact_values >= 2 AND n_distinct_body_sha256 >= 2. This is the parent's exact criterion, reused for identity continuity.
frozen_populations.anchor_verdict_rule: Per anchor and per path, verdict = RECOVERED_SESSION_SCOPED if that path recovers >=2 distinct non-empty exact values and the session-scoped criterion holds; RECOVERED_INVARIANT if it recovers exactly 1 distinct non-empty exact value across sessions; RECOVERED_EMPTY if in-list fields are present but all values are empty/absent; NO_FIELD if no in-list field is present; UNREACHABLE if HTTP 200 in <3 sessions. The anchor-level verdict is the pair (verdict_A, verdict_B) and is AGREED iff verdict_A == verdict_B.
frozen_populations.trial_population: All ordered recorded/current session pairs (Sr, Sc) with r < c among S1..S4 (6 pairs), for every included AGSI instance. The S1 -> {S2,S3,S4} subset is reported separately for continuity with the parent but is NOT the whole population.

drift_families.F-FRESH: live == recorded AND no structural, transport, endpoint or postcond change
drift_families.F-VALUE (D1V): live != recorded AND no structural change AND no transport change (parent's exact D1V definition); postcond change is allowed but stratified
drift_families.F-ENDPOINT: subset of F-STRUCT where form_action specifically differs; also reported via transport final_url differences
drift_families.F-TRANSPORT: transport_signature differs (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary)

frozen_populations.d1v_definition: Value-only rotation: STALE (live exact value != recorded exact value, byte-exact) AND NOT structural_change AND NOT transport_change. structural_change = structure_signature (type_class, form_action, form_method, sorted input_name_set) differs; transport_change = (ETag, Last-Modified, Cache-Control max-age, Vary) or final_url differs. endpoint_change and postcond_change are observed and reported but do NOT exclude a trial from D1V under the frozen rule. Family labels stratify reporting only; the guard never sees a label.
frozen_populations.ground_truth: For a trial (AGSI instance i, recorded Sr, current Sc): recorded_value = exact value in Sr; live_value = exact value in Sc; label = STALE iff live_value != recorded_value byte-exact, else FRESH. This is a raw observation with no interpretation and no injected ground truth.

decision_rule: ORDERED, FAIL-CLOSED. Every branch is pre-labelled MEASUREMENT_INVALID, DATA-INSUFFICIENT, BOUNDED NEGATIVE, or VALID RESULT; no branch converts a missing or invalid measurement into a scientific negative. PRE-FREEZE PRECONDITION (discharged in spec.pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run): the corrected GATE-C3 predicate and every declared membership class must be REACHABLE on pinned synthetic inputs before freeze; this spec is the satisfiability certificate. GATE C (pre-confirmatory certificate, before any extraction): C1 M-CERT-ROUTE-OK >= 3 of 4 AND M-CERT-FIELD-PRESENT >= 3 of 4; C2 M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-A == 0 AND M-CERT-NEG-VALUES-B == 0; C3 M-CERT-SESSION-ISOLATION-PASS == true (CORRECTED predicate: first_request_cookieless AND pairwise_disjoint_on_name_value_after_filter; session_identifying_disjoint NON-GATING) AND NC-CONSTCONFIG-EXCLUSION-NOT-VACUOUS == true. Any C1/C2/C3 failure => status MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome INCONCLUSIVE, branch F-CERT, no claim-level statement. C4 (non-blocking) M-CERT-BODY-VARIABLE < 3 => status COMPLETE, outcome INCONCLUSIVE, branch NO-BODY-VARIATION, no confirmatory read. GATE E (after GATE C): E1 M-CANARY-PASS == true; E2 M-FIXTURE-CANARY-PASS == true AND M-FIXTURE-EMPTY-AGREE == true AND M-FIXTURE-JSSTRING-VALUES == 0 AND M-GUARD-FIXTURE-PASS == true AND NC-PATH-INDEPENDENCE == true AND NC-TRIAL-CONSTRUCTION-STABILITY == true. Any E1/E2 failure => MEASUREMENT_INVALID, INCONCLUSIVE, branch F-INSTR. E3 M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VALUESET >= 3 AND M-EXTRACT-AGREE-VERDICT >= 3. If E3 FAILS => status COMPLETE, outcome MIXED, branch EXTRACTION-UNRELIABLE (M-N-EXTRACTION-UNRELIABLE >= 2); no substrate verdict. If E3 PASSES: D1 M-N-SESSION-SCOPED-CONFIRMED >= 3 of 4 => status COMPLETE, outcome SUPPORTS, branch EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED. Else D2 M-N-REPRESENTATION-LOSS >= 3 of 4 => status COMPLETE, outcome FALSIFIES, branch REPRESENTATION-LOSS-CONFIRMED (bounded). Else D3 => status COMPLETE, outcome MIXED, branch MIXED-ANCHORS. GATE B (PART II, read ONLY if D1): if M-N-D1V < 6 OR M-N-DECISIONS-D1V < 2 OR M-N-D1V-ANCHORS < 2 OR NC-NONDEGENERATE-ESTIMATOR fails (after its INACTIVE-ON-POPULATION waiver) => branch DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE when M-N-D1V-ANCHORS < 2, else branch DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V; part II reported null with reason, no false-accept or blindness claim; report M-D1V-BLOCKER-{anchor} and M-TRANSPORT-BODY-DERIVATION-{anchor}. Else if M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V >= 0.10 AND M-PAIRED-FA-DIFF-D1V-LOW > 0 => branch INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED: report M-FA-INCUMBENT-D1V and its UB97 as the explicit false-accept bound, and state that value-aware binding is necessary on this class. Else => branch INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND (F-BLIND). GATE B branches do not change status/outcome; they are recorded under metrics/controls/observations. Status/outcome map: GATE C or GATE E blocking failure -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE; C4 -> COMPLETE/INCONCLUSIVE; E3 fail -> COMPLETE/MIXED; D1 -> COMPLETE/SUPPORTS; D2 -> COMPLETE/FALSIFIES; D3 -> COMPLETE/MIXED.

claim_ceiling_rules.CC-A: All results are scoped to the 4 pinned credential-free, server-rendered, no-JavaScript, GET-only anchor URLs, K=4 fresh sessions, stdlib HTTP, on the capture date(s) recorded in provenance and one egress ASN. Prevalence over 'the Web' is NOT measured and must never be quoted.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-B: EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED (Part I) establishes that extraction was the parent failure mode on these anchors; it does not by itself establish a guard operating point, a session-scope prevalence, or an economic break-even. Combined with a READ Part II false-accept bound it measures the incumbent guard's behaviour on real value-only rotation. C-FRESHNESS may advance at most to EXPERIMENTAL, only via the DIRECTOR.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-C: REPRESENTATION-LOSS-CONFIRMED closes only the credential-free stdlib no-JS anchor-calibration path for these anchors. Client-side/XHR-minted values, canvas content, authenticated state and permission-boundary change remain open.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-D: The capability-token name list and the drift-family labels are string/structure-shape matchers, not mechanisms; labels that depend on them inherit that limitation.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-E: Part II false-accept bounds are anchor-clustered and descriptive; with few anchors the interval is coarse and must be quoted with its resampling unit. A D1V population spanning fewer than 2 anchors is DEGENERATE and licenses no false-accept, blindness or architecture claim (branch DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE); the single-anchor point estimate is descriptive only. No prevalence or generalization may be read from it.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-F: The two extraction paths are independently written but share a single authoring context; independence is structural (different algorithms, no shared code, AST-verified) and is corroborated by the real canary, the fixtures, and the four negatives, not by external authorship.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-G: The repaired session-isolation predicate exempts only the closed, frozen constant-configuration cookie allowlist; any other shared cookie name fails GATE-C3. New or unknown constant cookies are NOT auto-exempted, so the repair cannot silently become vacuous.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-H: If M-ROTATION-TIMESCALE is PER_REQUEST_SCALE for an anchor, any value-binding freshness verdict on that anchor is bounded to per-request/time-scale applicability and must not be described as 'session-scoped durability'.
claim_ceiling_rules.CC-I: NEW: the multi-anchor D1V evaluability question is bounded to the 4 pinned anchors under the frozen transport signature. If transport validators are body-derived or token-bearing, D1V is structurally unreachable on those anchors; a negative answer to the mandate's Q2 is a property of instrument × anchor, not of the freshness mechanism, and authorizes no change to the guard.

product_consequence_positive: If EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED is reached (E3 passes and >=3 of 4 anchors are confirmed session-scoped by both paths): (1) the grandparent's 4/5 zero-distinct failure is established as an instrument/extraction defect rather than a property of the credential-free Web, so the credential-free stdlib no-JS substrate remains a usable calibration substrate for C-FRESHNESS; (2) C-FRESHNESS may advance from HYPOTHESIS to at most EXPERIMENTAL, only via the DIRECTOR and bounded by CC-A..CC-I. If Part II is also READ and INCUMBENT-BLIND-CONFIRMED: the measured false-accept bound (M-FA-INCUMBENT-D1V with UB97) shows the value-blind incumbent guard is unsafe on real value-only rotation, so the shipped freshness architecture must retain CH-PRECOND-BINDING (value-awareness). If M-ROTATION-TIMESCALE is PER_REQUEST_SCALE, recording a token yields no durable freshness, so the guard must be treated as a short-lived applicability check. No promotion into Product Core is authorized by this packet.
product_consequence_negative: Pre-committed bounded consequences. (1) If REPRESENTATION-LOSS-CONFIRMED: no stdlib no-JS guard can be calibrated on >=3 of these anchors; bounded to the credential-free server-rendered class. (2) If EXTRACTION-UNRELIABLE: no guard measurement may proceed until the instrument is repaired. (3) If INCUMBENT-NOT-BLIND: the value-aware channel may be deleted, a real simplification decided by measurement. (4) If DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V OR DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE: Part II is reported null with its reason; only the Part I extraction read is licensed. The DEGENERATE case (M-N-D1V-ANCHORS < 2) additionally records the per-anchor blocker diagnostic and establishes that powering the blindness/necessity question requires a different anchor population or an instrument redesign -- neither authorized by this mandate. (5) If F-INSTR or F-CERT: no product change of any kind is authorized; C-FRESHNESS stays HYPOTHESIS and replay-by-assumption is not authorized. In every branch M-INVISIBLE-STALE-PREV is reported null, never 0.0.
estimated_cost: Very small. No model calls, no browser, no Docker, no credentials, no local server. Request budget identical to the parent: 16 positive-anchor GETs (4 x 4) + 16 negative-anchor GETs (4 x 4) + 8 warm-jar re-captures (4 x 2) = 40 plus same-session redirects, against a frozen cap of 200. Stdlib only (urllib, http.cookiejar, html.parser, re, ast, hashlib, json, math, random). Wall clock under 2 minutes at >=2.0 s per-host pacing. USD 0.
expected_information_gain: High and tightly targeted. PART I converts the parent's blocked instrument-level 4/4 dual-path agreement into a LICENSED result by applying the audit's exact predicate correction; reachable outcomes are EXTRACTION-DEFECT-CONFIRMED, REPRESENTATION-LOSS-CONFIRMED, or EXTRACTION-UNRELIABLE, and this is the first time that read can be taken because the previous two packets died on a control-plane defect. PART II answers the mandate's Q2 explicitly: the parent's single-anchor (M-N-D1V-ANCHORS=1) D1V population made the anchor-clustered lower bound degenerate, so this packet adds a pre-registered anchor-count requirement and a per-anchor blocker diagnostic. Because the frozen transport signature couples to the rotating value on CAL-POS-1 (body-derived ETag) and CAL-POS-3 (token-bearing final_url), the expected Q2 answer is DATA-INSUFFICIENT-D1V-DEGENERATE with a documented mechanism -- which is decision-changing: it tells the Director the blindness/necessity read cannot be powered on these anchors without a different population or an instrument redesign. The packet is small, uses the same frozen anchors and negatives for identity continuity, and cannot be reduced to another threshold retune.
